fixes.old: `id_no_token` (tokenization at load) is removed: there is no load. Role masking at the API (E1-037) replaces it. `party_type`, `id_type` and `segment` are the 3 SCBPDM columns ACE adds to `customer` in RWB-ACE-001; see T3.10, point 1. The Workbench flags move to `party_ext`.
fixes.new: **Tokenization point (GAP-0193).** For national ID and passport numbers, the tokenization point is `rwb-source-data` (P1): P1 mints the token at load and stores no clear value. This version defines no source load in P1 (D-RCV-35), so it adds no token column or view field, and `v_ace_customer` still exposes the identification number only as `id_no_masked` and `id_no_last4`. The token format and any detokenization path are to be fixed in this P1 design and in the access profile of P4 (`rwb-access`). Token format: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0193). Detokenization path: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0193).

disposition.note: P1 set as token point; format and detokenization path not specified. Check: 'at load' conflicts with D-RCV-35 (no P1 load; id_no_token removed), stated in the text.
